subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should macOS managed gateway services support a Volta shim fallback when no supported system Node exists?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but accepting it endorses a version-manager service runtime fallback while current docs warn that version-manager paths can break and prefer system Node migration.

options.title: Support Volta shim fallback
options.body: Keep the existing system-Node preference, normalize accessible Volta `tools/image` paths to the stable shim, and require focused tests plus live macOS LaunchAgent proof before landing.

options.title: Require system Node for services
options.body: Reject the Volta shim fallback, document system Node as the supported managed-service runtime, and close the linked implementation attempts as not planned.

options.title: Defer for live proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or contributor proves a real LaunchAgent install and Volta upgrade/reinstall flow with the shim path.

recommendation.title: Support Volta shim fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the existing system-Node preference, normalize accessible Volta `tools/image` paths to the stable shim, and require focused tests plus live macOS LaunchAgent proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent runtime-path refactoring point to this owner for the helper and daemon runtime-selection policy.
